svg.text: CJ2 Voice Emergency Checklist — DIY Wiring Diagram
ESP32-S3 + audio-panel input (isolated I2S codec, RX-only) + audio-panel output (isolated TX to COM3 channel) + two microSD (Config + Data) + Applied Avionics split-legend switch
Pin numbers match firmware/main/board_pins.h • DEMO / TRAINING ONLY — NOT FOR FLIGHT
analog tap OR buffered digital - selectable
Slot 1 = CONFIG CARD Slot 2 = DATA CARD
ISOLATED TX to dedicated aux channel
I2S DAC + isolation xfmr + line-level out
Separate connector from AUDIO IN (RX ONLY)
GPIO cannot drive a 28 V lamp directly - use a
SELECT G10 to GND when IN
VOX = AFE VAD on the panel feed
ESP32-S3 3V3 -> codec VDD, both microSD VDD
USB/VIN -> output line driver (low-current); lamp rail separate
common ground - all devices + lamp driver source
Budget: logic + peripherals < 250 mA; output line driver is low-current (~50 mA max); total USB >= 1 A (speaker amp removed).
